repos.name: InvokeAI
repos.note: openapi-checks.yml regenerates the schema from FastAPI and diffs it. Only invokeai/app is scanned; frontend and other packages are excluded.

repos.name: answer
repos.note: Makefile generate runs go generate; swag annotations live on the handlers for this Gin service. Known stale annotations: personal question page lacks its service prefix; activation uses plural users instead of user; notification config documents POST instead of GET.

repos.name: auth
repos.note: Maintained beside internal/api; the hosted prefix is declared at openapi.yaml:38 and absent from the root-local router (api.go:219-222,498,520). Reauthenticate has a stale documented verb.

repos.name: dvws-node
repos.note: scripts/generate-openapi.js generates this contract with swagger-autogen from src/routes; test/openapi.test.js checks the document.

repos.name: eShop
repos.note: Catalog.API.csproj exports OpenAPI during build with Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server. Both API versions are included; query-parameter version distinctions are outside endpoint scoring. Only Catalog.API source is scanned, not other services or shared default endpoints.

repos.name: immich
repos.note: Generated from server controllers by the OpenAPI tooling; .github/workflows/check-openapi.yml checks contract changes. Only server is scanned.

repos.name: owncast
repos.note: Makefile api-generate produces the checked-in chi server from this spec; /api is a real mount, not a prefix to strip.

repos.name: podinfo
repos.note: Makefile swagger regenerates this document from handler annotations; runtime path helpers remain part of the analyzer task. token/validate is annotated POST although registered GET.

repos.name: pokeapi
repos.note: Makefile openapi-generate uses Django spectacular; describes the REST API, not the separate GraphQL service.

repos.name: vikunja
repos.note: magefile.go Generate.SwaggerDocs runs swag; release automation regenerates and commits pkg/swagger. Only pkg is scanned; standalone example plugins and the frontend are outside this service scope. Known stale annotations: singular image instead of images in the Unsplash proxy; PUT rather than POST for label updates.
